whatIs.title: What Are All-on-6 Dental Implants?
paragraphs: All-on-6 dental implants are a full-mouth tooth replacement solution designed for patients who have lost most or all of their teeth. Instead of replacing each tooth individually, six strategically placed titanium implants support an entire fixed arch of prosthetic teeth.

whatIs.footer: If you're looking for a fixed alternative to removable dentures, All-on-6 dental implants near me may be the ideal solution.

procedure.title: Step-by-Step All-on-6 Dental Implant Procedure

steps.title: Consultation & Comprehensive Assessment
steps.description: A detailed oral examination, digital imaging, and treatment planning are performed to evaluate your bone health and overall oral condition.

steps.title: Implant Placement
steps.description: Six titanium implants are carefully positioned within the jawbone to provide maximum support for the new teeth.

steps.title: Healing & Osseointegration
steps.description: Over the next few months, the implants naturally fuse with the jawbone, creating a stable and durable foundation.

steps.title: Final Fixed Prosthesis
steps.description: A custom-designed full arch of permanent teeth is securely attached to the implants, restoring both appearance and function.
